**A.** The deposition is admissible as former testimony under FRE 804(b)(1): the engineer is unavailable, and the company had the opportunity and a similar motive to examine him when its attorney deposed him on the same safety-report and structural-defect issues. It is not a vicarious admission (B), because he was no longer an employee when he gave it, and it is not inadmissible hearsay (C) or barred for lack of cross-examination (D), since the company cross-examined him in the earlier deposition.
CONFIDENCE: 75
